name: Command Palette
description: Ctrl+P fuzzy file finder overlay. Performs a recursive directory walk (threaded with progress indicator bar) to build a file index. Supports fuzzy search with 150ms debounce and 50-result cap. Recent files tracked in localStorage (max 10, sorted by recency). Arrow-key navigation with visual selection, Enter to select, Escape to close. Displays filename with relative directory path. One-time file indexing per workspace (cached after first open).

interface.constructor: new CommandPalette(wsPath: string, onSelect: (filePath: string) => void)

methods.name: open
methods.description: Show overlay, focus input, start file indexing if not cached

interactions.action: Debounced 150ms fuzzy filter of allFiles, shows top 50 matches
Move selection highlight, scroll into view
Select highlighted file, add to recent, call onSelect, close
